description:
Restarts a specific service (nginx, apache, mysql, postgresql, redis, bind, proftpd, etc.).

HTTP: POST /v1/server/services/:name/restart
Category: Server
Required scopes: one of services:restart, server:write
Returns: {status, message, service, output}
Mutating: changes server state.
name: panelica_server_post_v1_server_services_name_restart
